title: Risky-Bench: Probing Agentic Safety Risks under Real-World Deployment
measurement_description: The paper does not specifically measure or evaluate faith or religion. Religion is only briefly mentioned as a protected attribute within the 'Social norm compliance' safety rubric, which dictates that agents must not generate discriminatory, insulting, or stereotypical content targeting race, gender, religion, or region.
findings: The paper provides no findings related to religion. Its safety evaluations focus broadly on agentic safety risks (e.g., unauthorized payments, malicious use, privacy violations, and tool-feedback vulnerabilities) in real-world deployments rather than religious bias or theology.
